title.narrative: Investing for impact to end Tuberculosis and HIV - Ghana (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Ghana, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Ghana (Ghana MOH)This program has the following goals: To achieve epidemic control and the fast track targets of 95-95-95 by 2025.. To reduce TB incidence by 25% from 148 in 2018 to 111 per 100,000 population by 2025. To reduce by 35% the 2018 TB mortality rate baseline of 52 deaths per 100,000 population by 2025. To reduce the proportion of TB-affected families who suffer catastrophic cost due to TB from 64% in 2016 to 0% in 2025. The objectives of this program are: Empower the population to prevent new HIV infections. Ensure the availability of and accessibility to prevention, treatment, care and support services. Mitigate the social and economic effect of HIV on persons infected and/or affected by HIV. Ensure the availability of adequate funding to execute the policy strategies.. To early screen, detect and enrol into treatment 90% of estimated all forms of TB (new and relapse cases): i.e. increase treatment coverage from 33% (14,597) in 2019 to 90% (34,374) by 2025 while increasing the proportion of bacteriologically confirmed pulmonary TB from 66% in 2018 to 70% by 2025. To early detect and enrol into treatment 90% of estimated RR/MDR TB cases among new and previously treated cases by 2025. To attain higher treatment success for all forms of incident TB from 85% in 2018 to at least 90% by 2025 through improved quality clinical care and community TB care. Provide Latent TB treatment or TB preventive Treatment (TPT) to TB contacts and PLHIV. To reduce death rates of TB/HIV co-infected cases enrolled onto anti-TB treatment from 19% in 2018 to 10% by 2025 and increase uptake of ART coverage among co-infected from 75% in 2018% to 100% by 2025. To attain high treatment success rate of RR TB and/or MDR-TB from 64% in 2017 to 90% by 2025

Percentage of health facilities which are reporting key programmatic indicator results on at least a monthly basis using a digital, individual level data system
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Percentage of adults (15 and above) on ART among all adults living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of high risk AGYW that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in AGYW programs
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- community referrals; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Number of people with TB (all forms) notified among prisoners; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Number of people in prisons and other closed settings that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of high-risk adolescent girls and young women reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- private/non-governmental facilities; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Outcome indicators targets and results for GHA-C-MOHP03

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed
Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period

Treatment coverage of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of notified people with bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated people with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Percentage of people living with HIV who report experiences of HIV-related discrimination in health-care settings
Percentage of HIV-positive results among the total HIV tests
Digital HMIS maturity profile score
Percentage of facilities providing HIV, TB and malaria integrated services to pregnant women
Impact indicators targets and results for GHA-C-MOHP03
Percentage of people living with HIV
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population

TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
